audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer said TRICKY 7/10 with Irelia owning rows 0-3 and 'Skill' on rows 4-6, while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Fizz on all seven at a 52.82% win rate.
audit.why: 52.82% over 2588 games is an even-to-slightly-favoured lane, not a 7/10, and the two layers disagreed on every row.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10, carryRating 7/10, tone amber, all seven sides moved to Fizz as one atomic group.

audit.why: Level 6 is the real swing: Chum the Waters knocks her up out of a Bladesurge chain, and spikes[1] already says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flawless Duet was tracked with no cooldown and its grounding was never mentioned; wants.foe[1] called Defiant Dance a shield; the late-game text gave her true damage.
audit.why: Flawless Duet (E) is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, stuns, Marks, and grounds. Bladesurge (Q) is 10/9/8/7/6, heals her, and refreshes free against a Marked target. Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge — it is no answer to your magic burst and it is not a shield. Ionian Fervor grants attack speed and bonus on-hit damage, not true damage.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, Do's bodies, enemyWin, wants.foe[1] and late all rewritten on the real text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Bladesurge's heal was never tied to an item timing outside report[8].
audit.why: Bladesurge heals on every reset, which is what makes an even-HP extended trade hers.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now names Grievous Wounds against the reset heal.
